about: Measured values of an open doctoral thesis, in the format of thermoml_<id>.json (read by measured_components.ThermoML). Extracted with pdftotext from the text layer of the thesis PDF, Table 7.1 (Appendix, printed page 153), 'Heat capacities of the melt', the (RS)-lactide columns (the racemate: CHEPTA's lactide, alias rac-lactide, whose melting data are the racemate's): 3 values, 408.7-428.8 K, high-temperature DSC. The table's 'Abs dev.' column (2.2-3.2 J/(mol K)) is used as each value's uncertainty; the thesis does not say whether it is an expanded uncertainty. Pressure not stated. The (S)-lactide melt values of the same table are not used ((S)-lactide is the enantiomer; at 408.7-428.7 K they lie 0.9-2.7 % above the racemate's): kept below as a cross-check only.

source.citation: H. K. Buchholz, Solid-Liquid Phase Equilibria of Chiral Molecules - Theory and Experiment, doctoral thesis, Otto-von-Guericke-Universitaet Magdeburg (2018)
source.access: Open thesis, free to read in the MPG.PuRe repository of the Max Planck Society
source.tables: Table 7.1 (printed page 153), heat capacities of the melt of (RS)-lactide, 408.7-428.8 K
